messages:
Alex: Heads-up — quiet window starts in 25m (21:00 PT). Running final launch-readiness sweep. Call out blockers or any emergency unpin needs.

Sophia: Running smoke on staging now (auth, inference, embeddings). ETA 7m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pinned: canary-2026-03-21-45 (service: inference, version: v3.14.2). To rollback: `/deploy rollback --to v3.14.1 --reason \"hotfix\"`.

Maria: Canary looks healthy so far. 1m error 0.09% (baseline 0.10%), P95 +4ms. Will monitor for 5m sustained anomalies.

Ron: Oncall here — set temp alert: error_rate > 2x baseline OR P95 > baseline +80ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/launch-freeze

Tim: Release notes posted. No DB migrations in this rollout, right @Dave?

Dave: Correct, only a config toggle in config-service. I'll be ready to toggle back if needed; will post timestamps.

Sophia: Smoke: auth ok, embeddings warmed, small cold-start spike cleared.

Alex: Rollback criteria — call rollback if any of these:
- sustained error rate >= 3x baseline for 5 minutes
- P95 latency > baseline +100ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows
- embedding quality regression >5% on canary eval set
If you hit one, post `rollback` and @sre-oncall will execute mitigation.

Maria: FYI: transient cache warmup can create short blips — if duration <2m, call it and we'll evaluate before flipping.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Automated rollback available: `/deploy rollback --auto` will stop canary, pin previous stable, drain connections, and run smoke checks. Updates posted here.

sre-oncall: Primary monitor for next 60m. Pager and phone active. I'll escalate to SRE manager if needed.

Alex: Repo lock in effect — no merges to main during freeze. Feature toggle fallback prepared.

Tim: Small docs PR pending — do NOT merge until freeze lifts.

Maria: Emergency unpin API: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/v1/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\"service\":\"inference\",\"version\":\"v3.14.1\"}'` (ops token required).

Dave: Standing by to flip config and will log actions.

Alex: Please ack once (one word) for audit.

Sophia: ack
Maria: ack
Ron: ack
Dave: ack
Tim: ack
sre-oncall: ack

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-2026-03-21-45 healthy; periodic updates every 5m. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks team — quiet channel unless incident or rollback. Pinning runbook to thread.
